statement: Video covers Luminous Menagerie boosts and doublers; doublers discussed at the end for easy reference.
Extra Menagerie missions boost scales aggressively; 19 levels at roughly 6-7 hours per level; critical for progressing missions.
Ranking up gives more Lumi boosts so keep mission boost progressing.
Keep missions boost and second shelf second upgrade roughly level with slight priority on the second shelf.
Straight extra Lumi boost scales maybe best of all Lumi boosts.
Never neglect extra Lumi boost; stay on it to pump Lumi gains since it unlocks everything else; near necessity for free-to-play.
Research EXP boost is a strong cheap multiplier; level 35 gives 4.5x; about 110 billion currently or ~300 billion on gain setup.
Research EXP lets you buy nodes E4 (extra Menagerie missions and hourly Lumi) and F4 (baby menagerie Lumi multiplier).
F4 Lumi multiplier is multiplied by rotated square shape past research level 90; it was what held him back from million range.
Recommends pushing deeper into research because the Lumi multiplier scales harder than expected.
Cooking speed boost is a very strong multiplier; his meals went from 140s to upper 150s.
He plans to get remaining meals to the 154-155 range then restart from the top.
Cooking speed boost is highly worth your time.
Get shrine max level boost to around his level; maybe one more; mainly for Crescent shrine Lumi gain after the next coral upgrade.
Shrine boost is a big additive bonus (140) and scales aggressively; do a level two or three.
2x cheaper summoning upgrades per 50 levels is probably good but he is holding off until he needs it.
Endgamers going deeper on this shelf upgrade reached about 400 endless summoning versus his 383; only about 20 levels.
Endless summoning is one of the big four mechanics he points people to when accounts have problems.
Not worth your time in the first couple days of pen archery; leave until week two or three.
Extra value for all sailing treasure is a big multi; level 5 already 2x; scales slowly.
Sailing treasure boost gives major increases across captains; costs very high even from minimal investment.
He keeps forgetting sailing claims; plans to build blue currency before another claim as gold bars may now go crazy.
Many things in this patch got a click-and-hold mechanic.
Pick and choose mechanic-specific boosts; put a few points in each to get rolling then focus on the ones you want to push.
He currently favors cooking speed; sailing-focused players might favor sailing; summoning gain also has two types.
Sushi doubler skipped for now.
Forge speed boost is the most useless in Menagerie; archer candy kill tech gives 45% chance of ~11 seconds of progress so forge speed is never needed.
Forge speed doubler just burns Lumi for no reason; maybe a future mechanic needs it.
Shiny critter value boost reportedly makes green stacking possible; he is skeptical but admits it is a strong multiplier.
Summoning essence boost with the shrine is needed to reach the 400 range; not worthwhile until a few weeks later.
Slow roast wiz gives 10 minutes of progress per level; 6 points means starting every worship at an hour of progress.
Slow roast wiz is bugged and not giving time; do not invest until a bug fix.
Orion first upgrade cheaper is expensive for about 6x; not worth it for now.
Orion boost brought his value from around e52 to 2.9e51; he considers it a month one or two thing.
He is closing on his next feather restart but needs a lot outside a merit week.
Atoms boost gives plus one level; he says front runners are in the 32-33 range with maybe a couple 34s.
Plus one atom level is good since some atoms benefit from a couple extra levels.
Construction atom is decent; trim slot is really nice; book atom is whatever.
Wood plate scales hard; increase was around six or seven QQ.
Star crypt atom is useless; he wasted atoms buying it.
Magnesium is fine; stamp supercharger is really good.
Minehead currency atom sushi books and jelly blood cell juicer atoms are fine; Lumi gain atom of course.
Helium atom is very expensive to level; he is only at about 20 of 71.
Helium doesn't work for the majority of power per 10 resource things anyway.
See the rest of the boosts on Idleon Toolbox; he avoids spoiling himself.
Hendo and Stack made a doubler priority tier list on Discord; he thinks it is accurate for this early.
Minehead mighty farmer (income) doubler should be your first; huge extra income.
Base damage two is a shoe-in second because it scales harder than base damage one.
Better numbers is only about 1.3x overall damage; people were baited; hold off if not yet bought.
More multi increases chance of higher multiplier tiles; monumental bonus.
Final round fury is what the meta revolves around: reach the last life then uncover the board; combines with triple crown hunter and multipliers.
He would rank final round fury ahead of more multi and tied second with base damage two.
His ordering: mighty farmer first; final round fury and base damage two tied second; then more multi.
He says he is not the minehead guy; take it with a pinch of salt.
Legal cheating button is good since you fish for many buttons on the final round; average about 4 with 25% break chance.
Even if a cheating button breaks you keep remaining uses; attack and go next for more on later runs.
Mega damage one multiplier is really strong; better numbers okay but much further down.
Golden tiles are not good; extra lives only lengthen runs for additive bonuses and are not worth it.
Bottom jackpot doublers could be strong later once there is more minehead income but not now.
Daily transfusion should be number one even though he hasn't done it yet.
Daily transfusion equals an extra two runs per day giving 200% of max blood cells or biggest run.
Daily transfusion gets better the earlier you do it; he regrets not taking it first.
Virus injection is strong but he would rank it about fourth because strongroid is better now though viral injection scales later.
Cell mutation is a huge damage buff not replaceable by other doublers; he ranks it first or second.
His order: daily transfusion then cell mutation then strongroid then viral injection then cell dialysis.
Mitochondria is not as good as going backwards and grabbing other stuff.
Don't sprint past diamond pit because the next one attacks faster and nukes blood cell gains.
Sandbag by going for sepsis over rash; rash would explode his run; eventually he must clear it.
Farming doublers can't be selected until they come up in rotation; he has a choice of eight.
He is saving his choice this week and covering it in weekly videos; wouldn't choose any right now.
Some chose legumes; a code post says land ranks never worked for exotic market.
Grapevine is possibly good as a strong multiplier; villager EXP not cared about.
He agrees free exotic and better exotic are number one and two.
Plump database should be top five.
Data digging agreed good; likely increases to plus nine or ten for the fifth database column.
Science-terrific gives extra bonuses from crop scientists and is amazing.
Sap surge and gravel pound are strong; he'd put sap sixth and gravel seventh.
Stalk value would fill out the rest of the top ten.
Prismarine exalted is probably too small a boost; artifact find maybe.
Hold onto some unused exotic crop doublers because more exotic crops may come in future.
He mostly agrees with the farming tier list but would swap some rankings.
Wholesale pricing is straight cost reduction and agreed good.
Bottomless shakers doubles chance of extra free usage; maybe number one with wholesale pricing second.
Late sushi revolves around sushi EXP; do third degree searing first then second degree searing.
Saffron shaker gives about 42 hours of books instead of one; he'd rank it four or five not three.
No tax multiplies all books by a huge multiplier; good.
He would add two extra upgrades to the list bringing it to seven; if worried wait another week for it to be figured out.
Both shakers are best for time-gated sushi; buy and never look back as the meta revolves around the three shakers.

subsystem: prisma bubble violet and honey yellow
statement: Gaming planet: Prisma bubble bonus for Violet and honey yellow for higher exalt stamp bonus; put two in each; do this and never look back.
Build rate is a massive multiplier needed for jellyfish and shrines; go for it third.
Ballot is the correct fourth pick; effectively extra 50% for him.
Most players should take bonus pal multiplier first; he took splonking pal which quadrupled his pal to 1e40.
He will update his arcade tier list; omega worthy ones are probably just the S-tier ones.
Current shop rotation is 74 and changes every four to six weeks; he thinks it should be weekly; covered in weekly video.
He believes he covered all doublers and luminous monoliths; ask in comments if missed.
